title: 京张相遇公地离线合成复演台账
summary: 把既有相遇票正例、预期拒绝样例与众智园空间夹具登记为逐条可复算任务。本台账只证明离线规则按预期放行或拒绝，不代表现场可用、安全、获授权、获得公众接受或产生实施绩效。
method: 使用包内无第三方依赖的 Node.js runner，对固定 JSON Schema 子集、跨字段规则、三份正例、五份预期违规样例与 S01 空间夹具进行确定性离线复演；不联网、不调用在线模型、不使用个人数据。

identifier_contract.scenario_id: Central repository scenario slug declared in proposal front matter.
identifier_contract.source_case_id: Concrete ticket or spatial-fixture case identifier used by the deterministic replay.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 字段、时序、授权、主持与权利条件完整时放行。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Release when field, chronology, authority, host, and rights conditions are complete.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 有来源、多语与人工转接条件完整时放行。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Release when source, multilingual, and human-transfer conditions are complete.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 无障碍活动沙箱的合成条件完整时放行。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Release when the synthetic accessible-event sandbox conditions are complete.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 日期格式不合法时拒绝。
开始、结束或删除时间顺序错误时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject an invalid start, end, or deletion chronology.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 请求禁止字段或越过最少数据白名单时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject prohibited fields or data outside the minimum-data allowlist.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 没有具名真人主持却声明已授权时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject an authorised state without a named human host.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 权利未清却声明公开发布时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject publication while rights remain uncleared.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 公众路径、隔离、值守、实体急停、AI 关闭旁路与复原六项齐全时通过。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Pass when public path, separation, duty holder, physical stop, AI-off bypass, and restoration are all present.
Reject when test separation is missing.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 缺少具名值守与停止责任时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject when named duty and stop responsibility are missing.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: AI 关闭旁路或退出受阻时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject when the AI-off bypass or exit is blocked.

tasks.expected_behavior_zh: 没有撤场复原责任与清单时拒绝。
tasks.expected_behavior_en: Reject when strike-and-restoration responsibility or checklist is missing.

urban_llm_harness.claim_scope: 十三条固定验证任务是否出现预期放行或预期拒绝；不是服务成功率或现场绩效。

encounter_ticket_contract_replay.claim_scope: 固定相遇票与 S01 空间夹具的确定性规则复演。

limitations: No live participant, venue, operator, public service, site condition, accessibility route, or field operation was tested.
The thirteen task outcomes mean that the deterministic checker produced the expected pass or rejection; they are not thirteen successful urban-service encounters.
The repository CI treats participant code as static evidence and does not execute it.
The package runner implements and fail-closes around the keyword subset used by this package; it is not a complete JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 implementation.
Field release remains blocked pending an authorised operator, a four-party site walk, verified venue conditions, and professional review.
